body:
I've often wondered why some cops are so diligent to enforce a law that cannot be enforced, at least not in any sensible way or by any reasonable means. It doesn't make sense to me and especially not when considering the drug in question.
I'm from Denmark, we have different cops here, not the catch-em-for-the-love-of-god cops, but more like the catch-em-if-you're-bored type of cops. They're really quite friendly and unless you're carrying around 100 grams, you'll get away with a warning or a ticked for 60 dollars. They know that losing your stash is punishment enough.
One time, sitting around at my dealers house smoking. The cops come knocking, they grab his stash (not much, around 30 grams) and asks if he has more. He actually reaches into his pocket and shows the cops (I'm really not making this up!) another 5 grams. The cops take it, smells it, bends it for a while and puts it down on the table with the other 30 grams. They ask a few questions, mostly about the hard drugs that have been appearing in town and a violent robbery a few nights ago. We have nothing to offer so they pick up the 30 grams and leave, we look at the table and behold, there was the 5 grams.
It can be nice living in small town in Denmark.
